mentions.name: ghost_trap
mentions.description: A small tool for fending off LLM scrapers and crawlers: a GitHub action that injects polymorphic prompt injections at the bottom of a repository's README.md, and a JavaScript snippet that injects polymorphic prompt injections into HTML so JavaScript-emulating crawlers such as Google's are also deterred.
mentions.problem: LLM scrapers and sophisticated JavaScript-emulating crawlers harvest content from READMEs and HTML pages; the tool injects polymorphic prompt injections to fend them off.
mentions.source_excerpt:
2. ghost_trap ( https://github.com/voodooEntity/ghost_trap )
A very small project i recently put out, nothing to serious but kinda funny and maybe usefull to one or another. It provides 
- An github action that will inject polymorphic prompt injections to the bottom of your README.md so LLM scrapers may be fend off
- An javascript that will inject polymorphic prompt injections into your html so more sophisticated crawlers like google etc which emulate javascript also may be fend off
